Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer provides some background about Yale and lists several lines of lyrics from "Boola Boola," specifically:  
Boola Boola, Boola Boola, Boola Boola, Boola Boola, Boola Boola, Boola Boola!  
Yale! Yale! Yale!

The Ground Truth Answer, however, gives a more extended segment of the lyrics, including these lines:  
Boola boola, boola boola, boola boola, boola, boola  
Oh when we're through with those poor fellows  
They will holler boola, boo  
Rah, rah!  
Oh Yale, Eli Yale  
Oh Yale, Eli Yale  
Oh Yale, Eli Yale  
Oh Yale, Eli Yale

Comparing the two, the Predicted Answer only provides a portion of the repeated "Boola Boola" section and "Yale! Yale! Yale!", which matches part of the Ground Truth but omits the rest of the key lines, such as "Oh when we're through with those poor fellows..." and any reference to "Oh Yale, Eli Yale...".

Since much of the substantive content of the Ground Truth lyrics is missing from the Predicted Answer, the vital facts (the full lyrics as requested) are not present.

Decision: FALSE
